findings.claim: Glasgow-2304 and a Mary Glasgow had children James (1806-1824), Neomi (1797-1831), and Rachel Glasgow Keller (1801-1855).
findings.reasoning: Three Gilders Creek inscriptions independently name Archibald and Mary as parents; Rachel's also names husband Isaac Keller.

findings.claim: The present Glasgow-3042 daughter relationship to Glasgow-2304 is unproved.
findings.reasoning: Sarah's cemetery inscription identifies husband James but no parent; the estate packet has not been inspected.

objective: Identify Archibald Glasgow's spouse and children from original probate and cemetery evidence.

questions.answer: Three children are strongly supported by stones; Sarah Glasgow-3042 remains tree-only.
questions.question: Which children of Archibald and Mary are directly supported?

targets.note: Inspect Archibald Glasgow's 1818 estate file administered by Mary Glasgow.
targets.reason: Prove Mary's capacity and name all heirs, including or excluding Sarah Glasgow-3042.

targets.note: Inspect the 1820 Ruth Glasgow and others guardianship with Mary Glasgow as guardian.
targets.reason: Determine which deceased Glasgow parent and children the guardianship concerns.
